A '''palace''' was built for the [[Unidentified Phlog king|king]] of the [[Phlog/Legends|Phlogs]] who lived on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon]] of [[Endor (planet)/Legends|Endor]] many generations before the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The construction of the palace had necessitated the felling of all the [[Tree/Legends|trees]] in the land of [[Desert of Simoom|Simoom]], which was turned into a [[Desert/Legends|desert]] as a consequence.<ref name="HEST" />
